title: Brent Briefly Tops $100 Amid Iran War — Houthis Strike Saudi Tankers, Iran Rejects U.S. Ceasefire
summary: Brent crude hit $101.06/barrel on July 24 — first triple-digit print since May — before falling ~4% to $97 by Friday close, still up ~7% on the week. Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis claimed attacks on two Saudi oil tankers in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait and declared a naval blockade of Saudi exports, threatening to cut off the Red Sea bypass to the Strait of Hormuz. Iran rejected a U.S. ceasefire offer; Trump warned of 'major military punishment' for further Houthi attacks. Pakistan, at China's initiative, is exploring new U.S.–Iran peace negotiations per Reuters sources.
why: 布伦特破百是本周最大宏观事件：推高全球通胀预期，直接驱使美联储9月加息预期从12%飙升至82%；能源进口型经济体（中国、欧洲）承压，港股/A股本周全线下行的核心背景。

title: Fed September Rate Hike Odds Surge from 12% to 82% as Oil-Fueled Inflation Reignites
summary: Fed funds futures now price an 82% probability of a rate hike at the September FOMC meeting, surging sharply from 12% just one week ago, as oil above $100/barrel reignites inflation concerns. The July 28–29 FOMC meeting is still expected to hold rates at 3.50–3.75%. Fed Governor Waller said the central bank must not repeat the 2021–22 mistake of waiting too long to act on rising energy-driven inflation.
why: 9月加息概率暴升至82%是本周美联储政策预期最重大变化，直接影响利率敏感型资产定价，压低成长股估值、推高期权隐含波动率；持有sell put的投资者须评估若9月加息则标的股价能否守住行权价支撑区间。

title: Wall Street Posts Back-to-Back Weekly Losses: Nasdaq -2.1%, S&P -0.6% — Alphabet -7%, Tesla -14% Drag Tech
summary: The S&P 500 finished near flat (+0.05% at 7,411.98) and Nasdaq slipped -0.64% (24,975.82) on July 24 (Friday), booking back-to-back weekly losses of -0.6% and -2.1% respectively; the Dow fell 0.4% for its third consecutive losing week. Alphabet sank ~7% and Tesla tumbled ~14% on post-earnings reactions. Chip stocks broadly weighed on the Nasdaq. Friday's day gainers included Apple +3.52%, Salesforce +4.05%, IBM +3.61%; biggest Dow losers were American Express -4.41%.
why: 纳指连续两周回调、大型科技股单日大跌显示市场对AI资本开支回报节奏的担忧正在定价；整体市场波动率上升，持有美股期权的策略须注意VIX走高带来的期权金重估压力。

title: 港股收评：恒指跌0.98%失守25000点，科指跌1.47%，阿里巴巴跌约4%、腾讯跌约2.3%
summary: 7月24日港股全线走弱，恒生指数收报24963.23点，下跌247.58点（-0.98%），盘中低至24812.50点，全天失守25000关口。恒生科技指数收4629.51点（-1.47%）。阿里巴巴跌约4%、腾讯跌约2.3%、百度亦同步下挫，科网股、黄金股全线受压，PCB概念股重挫。主板全天成交额2098.77亿港元，较前一日缩减约一成。市场将跌势归因于外围市场下行、油价飙升及美联储加息预期急升，10年期美债收益率盘中一度升至4.71%。
why: 恒指失守25000是本周港股关键技术位破位，科网股集体承压直接影响腾讯、阿里、美团等核心持仓估值；10年美债收益率4.71%叠加加息预期，对高估值成长股形成双重压制，sell put策略建议收窄行权价安全边际。

title: Alphabet Q2 2026: Revenue +24% to $119.8B, Google Cloud +82%; Capex Raised to $195–205B, Stock Falls ~7%
summary: Alphabet Q2 2026 revenue of $119.8B exceeded estimates of $116.9B (+24.2% YoY, 12th consecutive quarter of double-digit growth). EPS $9.11. Google Cloud surged 82% to $24.8B (beat est. $22.5B), the fastest growth rate in years. However, the company raised 2026 capex guidance to $195–205B (prior: $180–190B); Q2 capex alone was $44.9B, driving negative free cash flow of -$5.9B. GOOGL dropped ~7% on July 24 on concerns about the heavy AI spending trajectory.
why: 谷歌云增速82%确认AI基础设施需求强劲，但全年资本开支指引至2050亿美元级别已超预期，FCF转负令市场担忧AI变现时间线拉长；持有GOOGL头寸需关注本轮隐含波动率大幅上升后的期权策略调整。

title: Tesla Q2 2026: Record Revenue $28.2B (+26%) but Profit Collapses — EPS Miss, Operating Margin 1.4%, Stock -14%
summary: Tesla Q2 2026 revenue hit a record $28.2B (+26% YoY, beat est. ~$26.4B) on Q2-record deliveries of 480,126 vehicles (+26% YoY). But non-GAAP EPS of $0.33 badly missed the $0.53 consensus (-18% YoY). Operating income plunged 57% to $398M and operating margin compressed to just 1.4%. Capex surged 142% to $5.79B (AI/autonomy investment), producing negative free cash flow of -$1.09B. TSLA fell ~14% on July 24.
why: Tesla营收创纪录但营业利润率仅1.4%，反映FSD/Optimus大规模投入阶段价值不确定性高；-14%单日跌幅推高期权隐含波动率，持有TSLA sell put须重新评估Delta敞口和行权价位置，若仍看好长期逻辑可考虑在高IV环境下卖出covered call锁定权利金。

title: Intel Q2 2026 Blowout: Revenue +25% to $16.1B, EPS Doubles Estimates; 18A Yields 85%, Stock +13% After-Hours
summary: Intel Q2 2026 revenue came in at $16.13B (est. $14.45B, +25% YoY) — its strongest growth rate in 15+ years. Adjusted EPS $0.42 vs. $0.22 estimated. Intel Foundry revenue +31% to $5.76B; CEO Lip-Bu Tan confirmed 18A process node yields are tracking at 85%, ahead of internal targets, with a confirmed deal for a major cloud CSP on 18A. Q3 revenue guidance of $15.8–$16.8B. After-hours INTC shares rallied >13%.
why: 英特尔18A良率达85%是代工业务转型的关键节点确认，若后续CSP流片成功，INTC代工估值重估逻辑有望落地；相比上周Tesla和Alphabet的利空，Intel是本周财报季少见的超预期正面案例。

title: Tencent Leads China Gaming Sell-Off, Falls 7.1% on Mobile Revenue Fears — Biggest Drop Since April 2025
summary: Tencent (00700.HK) sank 7.1% on July 22, its steepest single-day decline since April 2025, dragging the Hang Seng Tech Index down ~3.5%. BNP Paribas noted 'gaming stocks saw a sharp sell-off amid rumours of declining Tencent mobile revenue' in Q2 2026. Peers NetEase and XD Inc. also fell >5%. The rout extended Tencent's 2026 year-to-date decline to more than 26% intraday. The stock continued lower on July 24 (-2.3%) within the broader HK tech sell-off.
why: 腾讯手游Q2营收可能下滑的传言引发最大单日跌幅，直接冲击核心持仓估值；若Q3财报印证手游收入承压，将重置长期价值中枢；短期建议等待基本面数据明确前暂缓sell put加仓，关注何时出现企稳信号。
